Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Nikhil - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Anjali - 39 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Rajesh - 36 years, father
Look: blue shirt, black trousers
4. Sharda - 66 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
5. Isha - 12 years, friend
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail

Places

1. The classroom - a blackboard, benches
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
4. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The classroom - Day

[Nikhil stands in the classroom. Anjali and Rajesh stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's do something fun today."

[Nikhil raises his hand to answer.]

Anjali (happily): "Show me too!"

[Nikhil writes on the blackboard.]

Nikhil (excited): "Okay, Dad."

[Nikhil reads his book at his desk.]

Nikhil: "Oh wow!"

[Nikhil yawns in the class.]

Nikhil: "One more time!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

Anjali: "Let's begin."

[Nikhil throws the ball to Mother.]

Sharda (laughing): "That's easy."

[Nikhil plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Nikhil (surprised): "Slowly, take it easy."

[Nikhil plays with his dog.]

Nikhil (laughing): "Really?"

[Nikhil feeds the birds.]

Nikhil: "Grandma, look at this."

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

Rajesh: "Anjali, look over here."

[Nikhil runs to Mother.]

Nikhil (gently): "That's great!"

[Nikhil climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Nikhil: "Dad, are you okay?"

Scene 4: The living room - Day

[Nikhil stands in the living room. Anjali, Rajesh and Sharda stand near him.]

Nikhil: "What a nice place."

[Nikhil writes in his notebook.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil's phone rings and he answers it.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

[Nikhil types on his laptop.]

Nikhil: "Mom, listen!"

[Nikhil watches cartoons on TV.]

Sharda (softly): "I really enjoyed today."
